content: How much in-force annual premium has Lakefront Brokerage Partners produced?

name: query_salesforce

content:
[Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmOAAU/view) produced **$1,147,109** in annual premium across **61 policies in force**. "In force" here means policies that are Active or Pending Renewal.

That's about 62% of the org's total in-force premium of $1,847,740.
